summary: Constructor-style initializer that zeroes a 12-dword member struct: writes 0 to every dword from this+0x0 through this+0x2C inclusive, then returns the this pointer. No reads, no globals and no callees.

local_names.this: object whose 12 leading dwords are cleared

operations.description: Zero the twelve contiguous dword members at this+0x0, this+0x4, this+0x8, this+0xC, this+0x10, this+0x14, this+0x18, this+0x1C, this+0x20, this+0x24, this+0x28 and this+0x2C
Return the this pointer as the function result

unresolved: The owning type of the zeroed struct is unknown; no caller or vtable evidence is present in the packet
